quote: Signature cafe items are rice-koji amazake, amazake soda and koji-based gelato, which are plant-friendly and naturally wheat-free options rather than dairy- or meat-forward dishes.
found: The page supports only the item NAMES — 「「かぶら寿し」などで培ってきた糀についての知見をいかして、甘酒や甘酒ソーダ、ジェラートをオリジナル・メニューとして開発した。」 plus 「甘酒プレーン360円、甘酒ソーダ420円…甘酒ジェラート520円、甘酒ゆずバジルジェラート520円」. It says nothing about plant-friendly or wheat-free, and it carries 「※掲載されている情報は、2020年2月4日以前に取材した内容です」. The operator CONTRADICTS the safety half: on kabura.jp every one of the nine 加賀・能登こだわりジェラート flavours declares 「アレルギー表示 一部に乳成分を含む」, the 9-flavour set declares 「一部に小麦・大豆・乳成分・卵を含む」, and 花きんじょう（ジェラート） individually declares 「一部に小麦・大豆・乳成分・卵を含む」 — wheat. 加賀金城味噌 and 加賀片瓜粕漬 add 卵.
http: 200 (plain desktop-UA curl) for kanazawabiyori and for every kabura.jp product page
method: 1 plain fetch of the cited URL, then kabura.jp /products/list?category_id=6 and each of the nine gelato detail pages for the maker’s own allergen labels; Yahoo Japan search to confirm the cafe is still trading
note: FALSE ASSURANCE, both axes. The gelato is NOT wheat-free (花きんじょう declares 小麦) and NOT plant-friendly (all nine flavours declare 乳成分, two declare 卵). The genuinely safe item is the amazake: 「材料はお米と米糀のみなので、からだに優しいノンアルコールです」 with a blank アレルギー表示 (kabura.jp/products/detail/300). Rewrite the positive around the amazake and amazake soda only, and name 花きんじょう as the flavour a celiac must avoid. The 2020 flavours cited (甘酒ジェラート, 甘酒ゆずバジル) are no longer in the range. Cafe itself is still trading — Kanazawa city tourism 2026 page and Tabelog both give カフェ 9:00-17:00 (L.O. 16:30), closed December.

why: limited — the record’s vegan_detail names the gelato, and 加賀棒茶 specifically, as plant-friendly, but the maker labels 加賀棒茶（ジェラート）「一部に乳成分を含む」 and describes it as 「棒茶の香ばしさとミルクのコクが優しく口の中に広がります」; 奥能登ミルク is 「奥能登の牧場ミルクの搾りたて」; 加賀金城味噌 is 「金城味噌に卵黄を加えた」. All nine flavours declare dairy and two declare egg, so zero gelato is vegan. What survives is drinks: the amazake is 「お米と米糀のみ」 and the amazake soda is built on it. Vegan choice exists but is confined to the drinks list, which is “limited”, not “options”.

options — the record hedges that 「koji/fermented products often involve shared production with wheat-containing items」, but the operator publishes a per-item allergen label and it exonerates most of the cafe range: the 甘酒 is 「材料はお米と米糀のみ」 with a blank アレルギー表示, and eight of the nine gelato flavours declare 乳成分 (and sometimes 卵/大豆) with no 小麦 at all. Exactly one flavour, 花きんじょう, declares 小麦. That is a documented wheat-free choice rather than a blanket unknown. Not higher than options: the in-store cafe menu is not itemised and the 2020-era 甘酒ジェラート is no longer in the labelled retail range, so a celiac still has to name the flavour and ask.
